objectives: Choose the right type of certification for a client's document.
Carry out a signature certification, including for documents about real estate.
Prepare a simultaneous certification of signature and content in the right number of copies.
Certify a copy and state in the endorsement what the law requires.
Calculate the fee for common certifications.

cards.front: Name the five certifications a notary performs on private documents and copies.
cards.back: Date, signature, content, signature and content at the same time, copy ([[gpk:589|Art. 589]]–[[gpk:591|591 ГПК]]).

cards.front: What must a person do for a signature certification?
cards.back: **Appear personally** and sign before the notary, or confirm a signature already made ([[gpk:589:2]]).

cards.front: A client signed a declaration for a real estate deal at home. What happens at the office?
cards.back: She **writes her full name** by hand and **confirms** the signature before the notary ([[gpk:589:2]]); fee 10 лв. = 5.11 € per signature ([[tarifa:5|item 5 ТНТ]]).

cards.front: How many copies for a simultaneous certification of signature and content?
cards.back: **Two or more** identical copies; one is filed in a special book ([[gpk:590:4]]).

cards.front: Which documents need signature and content certified at the same time?
cards.back: A power of attorney for a deal in notarial form; a transfer of company shares; a transfer of an enterprise; a marriage contract ([[zzd:37]], 129 and 15 ТЗ, 39 СК).

cards.front: A client presents a certified copy of a diploma and asks for a copy of it. What does the endorsement say?
cards.back: Who presented the document and that the copy was made **from another copy**, not from the original; any corrections or peculiarities ([[gpk:591:1]]).

cards.front: A lease has a certified date. The flat is sold a year later. Does the lease bind the buyer?
cards.back: **Yes**, until its term, but for no more than **one year** after the transfer ([[zzd:237]]). The certified date is the certain date ([[gpk:589:1]]).

cards.front: Where are date and signature certifications recorded?
cards.back: In a special register: the **general register** ([[gpk:590:2]]; [[n32:7]]).

cards.front: What happens to the private document after the certification?
cards.back: It is **returned** to the person who presented it ([[gpk:590:3]]).

cards.front: What is the fee for the first signature without material interest?
cards.back: 5 лв. = **2.56 €**; each next signature 2 лв. = 1.02 € ([[tarifa:5|item 5 ТНТ]]).

cards.front: What is the fee for certifying a one-page copy?
cards.back: 3 лв. = **1.53 €**; each next page 2 лв. ([[tarifa:6|item 6 ТНТ]]).

cards.front: What happens when the person did not appear personally for a signature certification?

quiz.question: A client brings a power of attorney to sell her flat, already signed at home. What does the notary do?
options: Certifies signature and content together; she writes her full name and confirms the signature
Certifies the signature only; she writes her full name and confirms the signature made at home
Certifies the content only; the signature made at home is enough for the document
Refuses the document; a power of attorney must be signed before the notary
quiz.explanation: A sale of real estate needs a notarial deed, so the power of attorney needs signature and content certified at the same time ([[zzd:37]]). The document concerns rights in real estate: she writes her full name by hand and confirms the signature made before ([[gpk:589:2]]). A signature made at home is confirmed, not refused.

quiz.question: How many copies of a share transfer contract does the office need?
options: Two or more identical copies; one stays in the special book
One original; the office keeps a photocopy of it in the book
Five identical copies, as for a deed that is subject to entry
One copy; the notary files the original in the special book
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:590:4]]: for a simultaneous certification of signature and content the applicant presents two or more identical copies; one is filed in the special book, the others go back to the applicant. Five copies is the rule for a deed for entry ([[n32:18:1]]); the original is never kept ([[gpk:590:3|Art. 590(3)]]).

quiz.question: A husband wants to certify his wife's signature because she is at home ill. What is the answer?
options: No; she appears personally, or the notary visits her for a good reason
Yes, if he brings her identity card and a note from her doctor
Yes, if she confirms the signature by telephone during the visit
Yes, if she signed the document before and he confirms the signature for her
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:589:2]]: the persons whose signatures are certified appear personally and sign, or confirm their signatures, before the notary; nobody confirms for them. For a good reason the notary performs an act that is not subject to entry outside the office ([[gpk:573:3|Art. 573(3)]]). A certification without personal appearance is null ([[gpk:576|Art. 576]]).

quiz.question: A client presents a notarised copy of a diploma and asks for a copy of it. What does the endorsement say about the source?
options: That the copy was made from another copy, not from the original
That the copy was made from the original diploma presented by the client
Nothing about the source; only who presented the document
That the copy has the same evidential force as the diploma
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:591:1]]: the endorsement states who presented the document and whether the copy was made from the original or from another copy, and notes any deletions, additions or corrections. Only an officially certified copy of an official document has the force of the original ([[gpk:179:2|Art. 179(2)]]).

quiz.question: A lease contract will be used against a future buyer. Which certification gives it a certain date?
options: Certification of the date of presentation
Certification of a copy of the contract
An apostille of the Ministry of Justice on it
A stamp of the landlord's company
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:589:1]]: a private document is presented to certify the date of its presentation; the certified date is a certain date towards third persons, and a lease with a certain date binds the buyer for up to one year after the transfer ([[zzd:237]]). A copy certification proves only that the copy matches.

quiz.question: A client asks to certify a signature on a blank sheet "to fill in later". What do you do?
options: Refuse; the certification covers a document with content
Certify it, with a note that the text will be added later
Certify it, if the client is known to the office personally
Certify only the date of presentation of the blank sheet
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:590:1]] applies [[gpk:580|Art. 580]] to the endorsement, and item 4 of [[gpk:580|Art. 580]] is the content; the notary also checks the content for legality ([[gpk:574|Art. 574]]). A blank sheet has no content to check, so none of the certifications is possible.

quiz.question: What is the fee for certifying two signatures on a declaration without material interest (no real estate)?
quiz.explanation: [[tarifa:5|Item 5 of the tariff]]: 5 лв. for the first signature (letter "а") and 2 лв. for each next signature (letter "в"): 7 лв. The 10 лв. rate is the fee per signature on a document for rights in real estate (letter "г").

quiz.question: What is the fee per signature on a declaration that will be used for a real estate deal?
options: 10 лв. (5.11 €) per signature
5 лв. (2.56 €) per signature
30 лв. (15.34 €) per signature
2 лв. (1.02 €) per signature
quiz.explanation: [[tarifa:5|Item 5]], letter "г" of the tariff: 10 лв. for each signature on a document that will be used to create, change or end rights in real estate. 5 лв. is the first signature without material interest; 30 лв. is the minimum of [[tarifa:9|items 9]] and [[tarifa:10|10]] for contracts with a material interest.

quiz.question: After certifying a power of attorney for actions before a bank, what must the office also do?
options: Enter an extract in the information system of the Chamber at once
Send a copy of the power of attorney to the bank that it names
Keep the original in the book of invitations, protests and copies
Send an extract to the Registry Agency on the same working day
quiz.explanation: [[n32:9а::5|Art. 9а, item 5 of Ordinance No. 32]]: an extract of a power of attorney for actions before a bank is entered and sent at once to the information system of the Notary Chamber. The document itself goes back to the person who presented it ([[gpk:590:3]]).

quiz.question: Which certified copy has the same evidential force as the original?
options: A certified copy of an official document
A certified copy of a private contract
Any copy that a notary has certified
A photograph of the document on a telephone
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:179:2]]: officially certified copies of official documents have the same evidential force as the originals. A certified copy of a private document proves only that the copy matches the document presented ([[gpk:591:1|Art. 591(1)]]).

quiz.question: A client presents an English contract that will not be entered. The notary does not read English. What is the correct approach?
options: Appoint an interpreter, or ask for a translation of the contract
Certify only the signature, without reading the text of the contract
Certify it on the declaration of the translator that the client brings
Certify it after the client summarises the content in Bulgarian
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:589:3]] applies [[gpk:582|Art. 582]]: when the notary does not know the language, an interpreter is appointed; in practice the office asks for a translation. The notary must understand the content to check its legality ([[gpk:574|Art. 574]]); a summary or a declaration of a translator does not replace that check.

quiz.question: A power of attorney had its signature certified in Varna on Monday and its content in Sofia on Friday. Does it meet Art. 37 ЗЗД for a sale of real estate?
options: No; signature and content are certified at the same time
Yes; both certifications were made by notaries
Yes, if the two notaries enter it in their registers
Yes, if both certifications are made within the same week
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:37]] requires a certification of the signature and of the content performed at the same time: one endorsement, one notary, one day ([[gpk:590:4]]). Two certifications on different days by different notaries do not meet the form.
